Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.smoother

Interface Vector3fTransitionSmoother

All Superinterfaces:
TransitionSmoother
All Known Implementing Classes:
AcceleratingVector3fSmoother, NaturalVector3fSmoother, XYPolarNaturalVector3fSmoother, XZPolarNaturalVector3fSmoother, YAcceleratingVector3fSmoother
public interface Vector3fTransitionSmoother extends TransitionSmoother
Interface for utility classes that generates sequence of Vector3f values. Typically it keeps an internal value and changes it towards a given target value gradually.
